cohort: 33,519 women undergoing intended vaginal deliveries at a single tertiary university affiliated medical center
finding: Prompt delivery in cases of umbilical cord prolapse is associated with favorable pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: The rate of umbilical cord pH <7.2 and 5-min Apgar score <7 was higher in the ARM group compared to spontaneous rupture of membranes, but there was no significant difference in mean pH according to mode of delivery.
